events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent working for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. I'm not a person. I can reset employee passwords, which sends a reset link to the phone registered to your account. I don't know which AI model I run on, so I can't tell you that.

Nothing you've shared so far has been sent anywhere. Once you're ready, please give me your employee ID. If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.
